messages:
Anna K: Following the postmortem, I pushed a compact runbook delta that focuses on triage heuristics and recurrence tracking. Need owners + firm ETAs.

Devon L: I can take the KV eviction correlation work. Will map eviction timestamps to compile/quantize jobs and surface a short log signature. ETA: 2026-04-06.

Maya S: I'll own autoscaler policy changes and the reproducible load job. I want to run a 30m canary with ramped QPS and provide a failure-mode matrix after. ETA: 2026-04-01.

Omar P: I'll update the playbook with a condensed escalation ladder and add the minimal triage payload to the paging flow. Proposal: escalation TTL = 8m before paging eng-leads.

Tina (oncall): Strong +1 for inline actions in pages. Oncall often only has the page content when outside laptop. Please include a micro-runbook (3 commands) and a symptom checklist.

sre-bot: Created TASK-3607 (eviction correlation), TASK-3608 (autoscaler repro), TASK-3609 (playbook delta).

Anna K: Micro-runbook suggestion to embed in page and playbook: 
```
# micro triage (run from redwoodctl bastion)
redwoodctl svc ls inference --wide
redwoodctl logs inference/<pod> --container=inference --tail=300 | grep -E "evict|cache|oom"
promql query "sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)" | jq .
# if thrash and evictions: /sherlock page infra-sre "latency thrash + evictions -> TASK-3607"
```

Anna K: Draft action list:
- TASK-3607: KV eviction correlation owner=Devon L ETA=2026-04-06
- TASK-3608: Autoscaler tuning + repro owner=Maya S ETA=2026-04-01
- TASK-3609: Playbook micro-delta + escalation TTL owner=Omar P ETA=2026-03-30
- TASK-3610: Three-week recurrence watch owner=Tina (oncall) start=2026-03-31 (weekly check-ins x3)

Devon L: I'll include two grepable markers and a small heatmap of eviction frequency per pod. Also will note model-compile windows to ignore.

Maya S: Will attach canary config (namespace: load-repro) and a failmap that ties CPU/GPU usage to latency + 5xx spikes.

Omar P: Playbook edits: add micro-runbook above to the page payload, add escalation TTL=8m, and a short "if infra-sre not reachable" fallback that pages eng-leads and product-ops.

Tina (oncall): I'll subscribe to TASK-3607/3608 and run the first recurrence check next week. Please add a one-line symptom summary to each task: "sustained latency increase + 5xx ratio rise + eviction events".

Anna K: Done, symptom line added to TASK-3607. Quick ask: Devon, add expected log snippets; Omar, mark TASK-3609 as high-priority so it deploys before the next on-call rotation.

sre-bot: TASK-3607 assigned to Devon L, due=2026-04-06. TASK-3609 assigned to Omar P, due=2026-03-30, priority=high.

Devon L: Confirmed, attaching sample logs to TASK-3607.

Omar P: Confirmed, will open docs PR and route to @docs-reviewers, will also add the page payload to the sherlock templates.

Anna K: Thanks everyone. Let's have a 15m sync Monday 09:15 to check progress and re-run ETAs if needed. If anything slips, update tasks and post in this thread. :thumbsup:
